newsitem.title: UK: DLJ appoints World Bank economist to London team.
newsitem.headline: DLJ appoints World Bank economist to London team.

text.p: Investment bank Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette said on Monday it had appointed former World Bank economist Charles Blitzer as its emerging markets chief economist, based in London.
"We are pleased that an economist of Dr Blitzer's stature and experience will be part of our London team," DLJ chairman John Chalsty said in a statement released in London.
Blitzer was formerly chief economist in the World Bank's Moscow office.

His appointment brings to 25 DLJ's European Emerging Markets Group, which trades and sells products based on central and eastern European assets. It also deals in assets of selected Middle Eastern and African markets.

Through its research and local expertise, the group is planning to become an active participant and intermediary, with particular focus on local markets, the statement said. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
